network.control: Node global fetch interception before SDK imports, not an OS firewall or network sandbox

scope: Project-run in-process fetch fault injection, not an actual website or RPC outage. Existing public npm releases run in an isolated consumer whose fetch implementation deliberately rejects all project API origins and every destination except the configured RPC. Root/issuer policy, context packet and original source bytes are supplied by the public checkout. Current graph and review state are read through one configured Arkiv RPC provider; provider completeness and metadata remain trusted. Both graphs and session wallets are project-controlled. This is not outside adoption, a state proof, an OS network sandbox, or proof that only Arkiv can implement a public record layer.
